# vcraft 1.4.1

A patch release: bug fixes, no new surface.

## Fixed

- **`--strip` (and `[build] strip`) actually strips.** The flag was parsed but never acted
  on, so the extension kept its symbol table. It is now a linker flag (`-Wl,-s`, or
  `-Wl,-x` on macOS), visible in `--dry-run`, with no `strip` binary needed.
- **`vcraft sdist` no longer drops source files.** It carried only `src/<module>.v`, so a
  project split across files rebuilt from its sdist into a module missing most of its API —
  silently. It now carries every `.v` under `src/` except the generated glue.
- **An enum or plain struct declared in a file that sorts after its use now resolves**, so
  file order no longer decides whether a project builds.
- **Enums are declared in the `.pyi`** as `enum.IntEnum` subclasses, so a type checker can
  see them.
- **`vcraft <command> --help` prints help and does not run the command.**
- The README's Requirements section lists Windows.

## Upgrade

```console
$ pip install --upgrade vcraft
```

No migration needed. Full list in
[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/rroblf01/vcraft/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#141---2026-10-16).
